interpretation: The exact production projector is numerically idempotent and retains 1.006 percent of the dense polar direction, matching the one-percent tangent allocation rather than selecting useful task directions.
Projecting the promoted coherent Muon direction collapses future-chord recovery from 16.47 percent to 0.167 percent.
Changing only the optimizer on the existing linear BlockFHT generator cannot solve the c_proj problem because every update remains trapped in the same task-independent fixed tangent.
The next structure must have a nonlinear task-conditioned moving tangent without introducing a learned dense basis or LoRA factors.
